synthesizedFacts.fact: Hormonal acne is more common in women and can occur well into adulthood, often presenting as deep, painful cysts on the chin, jawline, neck, and chest.
Hormonal fluctuations during pregnancy, menstruation, menopause, and conditions like polycystic ovary syndrome can trigger hormonal acne.
Hormonal acne can be treated with hormonal medications such as spironolactone and birth control pills, in addition to standard acne treatments.
